instruction: Latest user requests version greater than GitHub release, successful GitHub builds, publication, PR #6 update and a portal comment to post manually. Acceptance of the unresolved evidence gaps has not yet been requested/received.
scope: Proposed: publish GitHub 4.94 from reviewed main after passing Linux/Windows builds and exact jar identity checks; update existing PortSwigger/sharpener PR #6. Keep unresolved host/UI/provenance evidence truthful. No applicable vulnerability, failed automated check, wrong artifact, new dependency or BApp certification waiver. No portal comment will be posted automatically.

deferred_findings.finding: The ten identified Gradle/Guava advisories are fixed by the exact human-approved local composition. Complete native/shaded/build inventory, publisher provenance and managed-runner evidence remain incomplete.
Complete Stable and Windows/macOS/Linux channel matrix, including real host persistence/reload, remains unverified.
Live offline, multi-monitor/dialog, large-project responsiveness and memory evidence absent.
Advertised historical minimum Burp/API compatibility and final BApp/release metadata need reconciliation.
Real macOS/Linux host and visual taskbar/pinned-launcher evidence absent; Windows/macOS/Linux x Stable/Early Adopter matrix required.

Latest 4.94 Windows Professional 2026.11.2 run has 27 PASS, zero FAIL, clipboard opt-in BLOCKED and eight manual groups pending. Current Community results and the six-host/channel matrix remain incomplete.

Historical expanded Community rerun timed out at startup without assertions. No current 4.94 Community regression is available; earlier 21 PASS apply only to their original jar/catalog. No new activation is authorized.

Historical raw full UI reports were removed by an earlier clean build. Current 4.94 raw reports are retained outside build and bound by hashes in docs/manual-highlighter-size-guard-validation.json; historical raw evidence cannot be recovered.
Maintainer reports installed Windows main/taskbar icon does not change even unpinned; deferred for 4.93. Detached-window behaviour is separate.

community_basis: Shared APIs imply an expectation only, not a completed 4.94 Community regression.
artifact_binding: Release gate must emit source/jar/review/approval hashes and test results; read-only Windows build and isolated publisher must have identical jar SHA-256.

security_recheck.coverage: Unchanged 99 recorded runtime/test/metadata and identifiable Gradle Maven coordinates, including Gradle core and replacement Guava parent. Compare with docs/release-4.93-approval.json. Complete shaded/native provenance remains incomplete; no universal clean bill or new dependency admission.
